howToApply: Visit the official website www.neepco.co.in and navigate to the Careers section.
The online registration portal will be functional from 00:01 Hrs of 11-08-2026 to 23:59 Hrs of 31-08-2026.
Ensure you are registered in Agartala Employment Exchange or Sepahijala Employment Exchange and possess Tripura state domicile.
Fill in the online application form with accurate details including a valid email ID (which must remain active for at least one year).
No application fee is required.
Submit the application online. No manual/paper application will be accepted.
Download the Admit Card from the Recruitment Portal once available. Admit cards will not be sent by post.
Candidates already working in Government/Public Sector Enterprises must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of written test.

howToApply: Download the prescribed application proforma from Annexure-I.
Fill in the application form with all required details.

Attach scanned copies of the following self-attested certificates: Two recent passport size photos, Certificate of Date of Birth (10th certificate), EWS/SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate (if applicable), MBBS passed Certificate, MBBS Marksheets, MBBS Attempt certificate, MBBS Internship Completion Certificate, Medical Registration Certificate for MBBS, NOC from present employer (if employed), MCI/NMC Eligibility certificate (for foreign medical institution candidates), Result of screening test for Indian nationals with Foreign Medical Qualifications issued by the National Board of Examinations.
Send the completed application along with all scanned documents by email to neigrihms.recruitment@gmail.com before 18th August 2026 up to 5:30 PM.
Bring original documents at the time of interview.

howToApply: Visit the Bank’s official website https://pnb.bank.in/ under Recruitment/Career section.
Click on the link ‘CLICK HERE FOR NEW REGISTRATION’ to register your application by entering basic information.
Note down the provisional registration number and password generated by the system.
Fill in the online application form carefully with all required details.

Scan and upload photograph, signature, left hand thumb impression, handwritten declaration, proof of age, caste/disability certificate, educational qualification, and work experience documents as per specified guidelines.
Pay the application fee online using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets, or UPI.
Submit the application form after verifying all details.
Take a printout of the e-receipt and online application form for future reference.
Applications can be submitted from 20.07.2026 to 09.08.2026 only.

howToApply: Interested and eligible candidates must appear directly at the walk-in-interview venue on the scheduled date.
Carry Biodata in the prescribed format (available at https://nesac.gov.in/category/career/) neatly typed (handwritten not accepted).
Bring all relevant original documents as proof of details furnished in the Biodata along with a set of self-attested photocopies.
Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate Biodata for each post.
Candidates employed under Central/State Government/Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies must produce original ‘No Objection Certificate’ at the time of interview.
Candidates must carry a valid Government-issued identity card (Aadhaar/Passport etc.) for identity verification.
Only passed candidates are eligible; students awaiting final results need not appear.
For any issues in downloading the Biodata format, email: ao.nesac@nesac.gov.in

title: NEIAH Meghalaya Recruitment 2026 – Teaching & Non Teaching Posts
shortInfo: NEIAH Meghalaya has announced notification for Teaching & Non Teaching posts. Required qualification: M.Phil/Ph.D, Any Post Graduate. Last date to apply: 17-08-26.

dates.event: Last Date for Receipt of Applications

howToApply: Download the prescribed application form from the official website: www.neiah.nic.in.
Fill in the application form completely in all respects.
Attach self-attested copies of all certificates, mark sheets, and testimonials in support of age, educational qualifications, experience, Caste/Community/PWD/EWS issued by Competent Authority.
Attach Council Registration certificate and Teacher’s Code (as applicable).
Attach two recent passport size colour photographs.

Attach non-refundable application fee in the form of Bank Demand Draft (DD) in favour of “Director, North Eastern Institute of Ayurveda & Homoeopathy” payable at Shillong. Write candidate name, category, and post applied for on the back of the DD.

Candidates applying on deputation must attach duly attested photocopies of all necessary documents, up-to-date Confidential Reports (at least for the latest 05 years), Vigilance Clearance certificate, and attested copies of CR Dossiers.
Attach No Objection Certificate and Experience Certificate in the prescribed format (Annexure-I) from the employer.
Super-scribe the envelope: “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ________________ Sl No.________”.
Send the application by Registered Post / Speed Post to: The Director, North Eastern Institute of Ayurveda & Homoeopathy (NEIAH), Mawdiangdiang, Shillong, Meghalaya – 793018.
Applications must reach the Institute on or before 17.08.2026 (45 days from date of publication in Employment News on 04.07.2026).
